name: a link hiding a tab
why: A browser strips a tab from an address before it parses it, so the two segments here that read as broken text are '..' and '..' by the time it resolves them: https://github.com/evil/x. No segment reads as a dot segment literally, so the tab is the only thing that gives this away. It is refused twice over, and by the first rule it meets: a control character anywhere in a fact is refused before any link is read, as a backslash is (link-with-backslashes.json), and the link rule refuses the address too -- that half is pinned on its own in tests/test_rules.py.
